entries.title: Psalms 87:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm [or] Song for the sons of Korah.>> His foundation [is] in the holy mountains. {for the sons: or, of the sons}

words.text: . {for the sons: or, of the sons}

entries.title: Psalms 87:2
segments: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 87:3
segments: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 87:4
segments: ¶I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this [man] was born there.

entries.title: Psalms 87:5
segments: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

entries.title: Psalms 87:6
segments: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, [that] this [man] was born there. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 87:7
segments: As well the singers as the players on instruments [shall be there]: all my springs [are] in thee.

words.text: on instruments [shall be there]: all my springs
